note: Exact normative statements and stable IDs extracted from the governing v0.3 specification. Not the complete IR schema; applicability, machine expressions and milestone evidence still require assessment.

entries.normative_statement: Every concrete authoritative AsmWeb implementation limit SHALL have exactly one canonical LIM-* identity.
Every concrete machine-verifiable project invariant governed by this specification SHALL have exactly one canonical INV-* identity.
OLR, MOT, RCT, configuration, implementation, tests and evidence SHALL reference canonical invariant/limit identities rather than create competing authorities.
This specification SHALL NOT redefine Runtime-owned object layouts, pool mechanics or resource-management algorithms.
This register SHALL NOT invent numerical values merely to eliminate an unresolved decision.
A build SHALL NOT claim qualification against an invariant/limit set whose authoritative IR or LR fails validation.
UNRESOLVED SHALL mean that a decision remains unresolved; it SHALL NOT mean that runtime behaviour may be unbounded.
Every ACTIVE invariant and limit SHALL have deterministic applicability to a particular build/configuration.
A non-applicable limit SHALL NOT be treated as unresolved.
The Effective Limit Manifest SHALL include the applicable subset for the identified build/configuration.
Capacity, work, rate and deadline limits SHALL NOT be treated as interchangeable controls.
A rate value without defined interval/window semantics SHALL NOT constitute a complete enforceable rate limit.
An effective limit SHALL NOT exceed an applicable hard protocol, platform, provider, build or dependency constraint.
A standards-derived limit SHALL NOT rely solely on undocumented institutional memory for its origin.
Registry expression evaluation SHALL NOT rely upon machine integer wraparound.
Expression dependency cycles SHALL be rejected unless a separately specified fixed-point model permits them.
Rounding behaviour affecting a derived bound SHALL be explicit.
Registry validation SHALL reject dimensionally invalid expressions.
A rational threshold SHALL define exact operands and rounding semantics.
Two independent authoritative numeric entries SHALL NOT represent the same conceptual limit merely because they currently contain equal values.
A local scope SHALL NOT admit work or state causing an authoritative enclosing scope to exceed applicable capacity.
current_occupancy ≤ configured_capacity ≤ physical_capacity
advertised_capacity ≤ configured_capacity
ordinary_usable_capacity + protected_reserves ≤ physical_capacity
Required capacity dependencies SHALL be satisfiable before READY.
free_count + in_use_count = physical_pool_capacity
A live child object SHALL have a live parent or a valid explicitly transferred owner according to its object model.
A released object SHALL have no live exclusive owner.
A queued object SHALL have exactly one defined owner according to the queue/object contract.
A reusable buffer SHALL have no outstanding borrow that permits access under its previous ownership/lifetime.
An asynchronous reference SHALL identify a currently valid live identity before it may mutate object state.
An active event registration SHALL have a valid live owner according to the event-registration contract.
Current resource accounting SHALL remain non-negative.
Derived-capacity arithmetic SHALL fail validation rather than wrap, truncate or silently saturate.
Dependency evaluation SHALL preserve units and dimensions.
A derived limit SHALL retain traceability to all authoritative operands contributing to its effective value.
Ordinary traffic SHALL NOT consume protected reserve capacity unless an explicit borrowing rule permits it.
v1 SHALL NOT assume implicit reserve borrowing.
Reserve consumption SHALL remain visible to resource accounting.
Reserve capacity plus ordinary usable capacity SHALL satisfy governing physical capacity.
Pressure thresholds SHALL be ordered consistently with the capacity they govern.
A pressure threshold SHALL NOT exceed the effective capacity of its resource.
Security and Runtime pressure handling SHALL consume the same authoritative threshold identities.
Registry expressions and evidence SHALL distinguish resource-pressure state from process-lifecycle state.
Every externally reachable ACTIVE limit SHALL have deterministic over-limit behaviour.
Current accounting SHALL NOT silently wrap.
Historical accounting SHALL NOT silently wrap.
Accounting overflow SHALL have deterministic handling.
Resource-accounting updates SHALL themselves have bounded computational cost.
Current occupancy and historical work SHALL remain semantically distinct.

Each externally driven parser step SHALL do at least one of: consume input; make a valid state transition; complete; reject; explicitly enter an await-more-input state. A parser SHALL NOT spin indefinitely while consuming no input, making no state transition and awaiting no external condition.
An attacker-controlled iteration count SHALL NOT execute without an applicable finite termination condition.
Releasing an object SHALL NOT automatically erase historical work where that would permit churn to bypass a work limit.
Aggregate batch work SHALL remain bounded even where individual elements satisfy local limits.
Applicable post-grace retained state SHALL be completely accounted for by the derived baseline and permitted retained-state classifications.
Persistent state intentionally excluded from zero-baseline expectations SHALL be explicitly identified.
UNEXPLAINED_RETAINED SHALL prevent applicable quiescence qualification from passing.
CONFIRMED_LEAK SHALL constitute qualification failure for the affected invariant.
A high-water value SHALL NOT be interpreted without its measurement interval.
The normal request-processing path SHALL NOT require a general-purpose heap.
Every runtime memory class capable of externally influenced acquisition SHALL be registered and bounded.
Each live runtime object SHALL have exactly one valid ownership disposition.
An object SHALL NOT return to reusable storage while a valid owning or protocol-required reference depends upon it.
Recycled storage SHALL NOT permit a stale earlier-lifetime reference to mutate the new occupant.
Every externally visible byte SHALL be initialised before exposure.
Secret-bearing storage requiring destruction SHALL be sanitised according to its secret-lifetime rule before ordinary reuse.
Pool exhaustion SHALL be bounded exhaustion, not memory corruption.
Multi-resource acquisition SHALL either commit valid acquisition or restore ownership/capacity according to transactional rollback.
Variable-sized storage SHALL NOT escape the registered aggregate memory ceiling because individual allocations are independently bounded.
Stack and scratch storage participating in the bounded memory model SHALL have authoritative registered limits.
Scratch use SHALL NOT permit externally induced unbounded nesting or aggregate consumption.
Direct configured memory-ceiling arithmetic SHALL count each physical storage region exactly once.
No hostile-input-reachable queue SHALL grow without an authoritative bound.
Queue capacity SHALL include separately retained backing.
Deferred reclamation SHALL itself use bounded registered state.
Waiting for capacity SHALL NOT create an unregistered unbounded waiter population.
A connection SHALL NOT become admitted when required capacity is unavailable.
A stream SHALL NOT become live when required capacity is unavailable.
Handshake admission SHALL respect handshake and dependent capacity.
Input retained beyond immediate parsing SHALL be charged to a bounded resource.
A body MAY exceed simultaneously retained body memory only where streaming preserves bounded retention.
A slow peer SHALL NOT cause retained RX/TX storage to grow without bound.
Descriptor capacity SHALL be bounded independently where descriptors consume distinct storage.
A rate limit SHALL identify its numerator, denominator/interval and scope.
A burst allowance SHALL itself be bounded and represented explicitly where applicable.
A slow reader SHALL NOT force arbitrary retained output.
Error handling SHALL NOT create unbounded output amplification.
QUIC pre-validation output SHALL obey applicable anti-amplification constraints.
Wall-clock adjustment SHALL NOT invalidate a monotonic security/resource deadline.
Trivial activity SHALL NOT automatically extend a useful-progress deadline.
Deadline expiry SHALL have deterministic ownership/reclamation consequences.
A timer SHALL NOT retain an otherwise reclaimable object indefinitely beyond its defined lifetime semantics.
Once the authoritative drain deadline expires, remaining applicable work SHALL receive deterministic lifecycle termination according to the governing lifecycle specification.
The validated configured value, canonical LR value, MOT/RCT projection and provisioned runtime capacity SHALL reconcile according to their authoritative expressions before READY.
Runtime enforcement SHALL use the validated effective value rather than independently reparsing raw configuration.
A discrepancy between authoritative registry value and provisioned runtime capacity SHALL prevent READY where the discrepancy invalidates a mandatory capacity relationship.

READY implies that every mandatory applicable invariant/limit required for the current milestone has resolved successfully, required capacity relationships hold, required IR/LR/OLR/MOT/RCT references reconcile, required platform/provider constraints have been processed, and mandatory startup invariant validation has passed.
Protocol-specific decoding SHALL NOT bypass common semantic field limits.
Trailers SHALL remain subject to authoritative limits across H1/H2/H3.
Total accepted body size and simultaneously retained body size SHALL remain distinct quantities where both apply.
An accepted H1 request SHALL have one unambiguous framing interpretation.
Peer-advertised/requested values SHALL NOT force AsmWeb beyond effective provisioned capacity.
HPACK dynamic state SHALL remain within its authoritative memory bound.
HPACK decoding SHALL remain within semantic-output and work limits.
Unknown but permitted H3 frames SHALL remain resource-accounted.
QPACK blocked-stream state SHALL remain bounded.
QPACK table state SHALL remain bounded.
QPACK decoding SHALL remain within semantic-output and work limits.
TLS failure before HTTP establishment SHALL NOT consume semantic HTTP request capacity.
Provider state required by an admitted handshake SHALL participate in applicable capacity modelling.
Unknown provider-internal memory SHALL NOT be counted as zero in total-resource claims.
A known-truncated datagram SHALL NOT be treated as complete.
Multiple packets in one datagram SHALL remain subject to aggregate datagram work limits.
Multiple datagrams in one batch SHALL remain subject to aggregate batch work limits.
Pre-validation output SHALL obey applicable QUIC anti-amplification requirements.
ACK-range, recovery, reassembly and connection-ID state SHALL remain bounded.
Network-derived path processing SHALL remain bounded.
Path handling SHALL NOT escape the configured content root.
Static serving SHALL NOT require full-file userspace buffering.
MIME lookup SHALL operate over a finite reproducibly identified mapping.
Unsupported filesystem object types SHALL NOT become servable merely because the operating system can open them.
Arbitrary attacker-controlled values SHALL NOT create unbounded persistent metric cardinality.
Diagnostic hostile-input capture SHALL have a finite byte bound.
Observability failure/saturation SHALL NOT invalidate core memory/resource invariants.
Metrics and health generation SHALL remain bounded.
UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL SHALL NOT be represented as zero cost.
Startup SHALL reconcile applicable configured capacities with known OS constraints before READY where required for safe admission.
External exhaustion SHALL remain distinguishable from internal configured exhaustion.
Release claims SHALL NOT exceed the guarantee permitted by the external-resource classification.
An external resource SHALL NOT be promoted to a stronger claim class without evidence supporting the stronger classification.

If instrumentation changes object size, metadata, pool capacity, direct memory contribution, guard/scratch requirement or another effective limit, the instrumented build's derived limits SHALL reflect that change.
Evidence obtained from an instrumented build SHALL identify the instrumentation profile and SHALL NOT silently be attributed to materially different production limits.
Qualification evidence SHALL be attributable to an identifiable ELM.
The ELM SHALL be generated from authoritative sources and SHALL NOT become an independent numerical authority.
An unresolved limit SHALL NOT reach a milestone requiring enforcement without resolution or explicit controlled deferral.
UNRESOLVED SHALL NOT mean unlimited.
A provisional value SHALL NOT silently become permanent through implementation inertia.
Qualification SHALL test limit composition, not only isolated limits.
Passing a local-limit test SHALL NOT establish a global boundedness property.
Evidence SHALL identify the ELM and effective values under which qualification occurred.
A limit change SHALL NOT be treated as harmless configuration where it invalidates a qualified invariant/resource relationship.
A changed operand SHALL trigger reevaluation of every dependent derived limit.
Hard implementation ceilings SHALL have the same traceability expectations as configured limits.
External-resource claim-class promotion SHALL require supporting evidence; weakening may occur whenever evidence invalidates the stronger claim.
